← Spec Tracker

SPEC TRACKER / FORECAST ACCOUNTABILITY

Forecast report card

The forecast declared 2026-08-11, checked at two fixed settlement checkpoints.

This measures agreement with publisher tier-list consensus, not objective game performance. Shared publisher blind spots remain ungraded. Settlement means the first saved consensus at least 14 or 28 days after launch; it does not certify that every publisher refreshed that day. Publisher-specific outcome dates are not recorded in these history snapshots.

+14 days · 2026-09-01  ·  +28 days · pending

Coverage: 80/80 gradeable cells (100%). 0 declined · 0 without an outcome · 0 roster gaps.

41% exact letters · 89% within one band

Mean absolute error: 0.7 bands; signed bias: -0.2 bands. Positive bias means the forecast was too optimistic. Carry-forward: 21% exact, 71% within one band.

Ordering within each role

Forecast and carry-forward use the same settled outcome. Higher is better for all ranking measures; a dash means insufficient evidence. Top-k is 5 for DPS and 3 for tanks/healers. Carry-forward copies the artifact's pre-launch live consensus.
